ruleDefinitions.name: Uncommon Child Processes Of SndVol.exe
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potentially uncommon child processes of SndVol.exe (the Windows volume mixer)

sequences.query: parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\SndVol\\\.exe$") AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ shell32\\\.dll\\,Control\\_RunDLL\\ .*")))
